      Key Focus: Privacy Controls, Audit Logging, Security Testing

#14 - 🚀 Epic: Add Internationalization and Accessibility Support

      Sub-Issues: #46-54 (9 tasks)

ISSUE LINKING STRATEGY
================================================================================

All sub-issues contain: "**Parent Issue**: Relates to #[NUMBER]"

This enables:
  ✅ Bidirectional navigation between epics and sub-issues
  ✅ Easy cross-referencing in GitHub UI
  ✅ Automated relationship tracking
  ✅ Project board organization by epic

================================================================================
GITHUB PROJECT SETUP RECOMMENDATION
================================================================================

1. Create GitHub Project: "News Analytics Platform v2.0"
   
2. Set up columns:
   - Backlog (all 50 issues)
   - Ready (approved for start)
   - In Progress (being worked)
   - In Review (PR submitted)
   - Testing (QA verification)
   - Done (completed & merged)

3. Create Epic Swim Lanes:
   - Lane 1: Performance (#11 parent + #16-24 sub)
   - Lane 2: Security (#12 parent + #26-34 sub)
   - Lane 3: API (#13 parent + #36-44 sub)
   - Lane 4: i18n/a11y (#14 parent + #46-54 sub)
   - Lane 5: Docs (#15 parent + #55-63 sub)

4. Set Labels:
   - epic-performance
   - epic-security
   - epic-api
   - epic-i18n-a11y
   - epic-docs
   - type-feature
   - type-testing
   - type-documentation
   - priority-high
   - priority-medium
   - priority-low

5. Milestones:
   - v2.0-phase-1: Security + Performance (8 weeks)
   - v2.0-phase-2: API + i18n/a11y (10 weeks)
   - v2.0-phase-3: Docs + Community (6 weeks)

================================================================================
HOW TO USE THIS ROADMAP
================================================================================

For Project Managers:
  1. Open ROADMAP.md for strategic overview
  2. Use ISSUES_VISUAL_GUIDE.md to understand structure
  3. Create GitHub Project with epic swim lanes
  4. Track sub-issue completion rate per epic
  5. Monitor dependencies between epics

For Team Leads:
  1. Assign parent epic (#11-15) to your team
  2. Break into sprints using sub-issues (#16-24, etc.)
  3. Ensure each sub-issue has acceptance criteria met
  4. Track blockers and dependencies
  5. Update parent epic with progress

For Developers:
  1. Find your assigned sub-issue
  2. Read parent epic for context
  3. Review acceptance criteria
  4. Complete all tasks in sub-issue
  5. Ensure 100% test coverage
  6. Update documentation (Task I)
  7. Submit PR with reference to issue

================================================================================
QUALITY GATES (Non-Negotiable)
================================================================================

For ALL work (per Copilot Instructions):
  ✅ Typecheck passes (no `any` creep)
  ✅ Lint passes (no new warnings)
  ✅ Build passes
  ✅ All tests pass (100% coverage)
  ✅ No secrets committed
  ✅ Docs updated when behavior changes
  ✅ Observability updated (logs/metrics/traces)
  ✅ PR includes new/updated tests
  ✅ PR includes regression tests
  ✅ At least one negative test per new API/feature
